title: Asus Put NVIDIA's RTX Spark in a $4,499 Box This TINY 😳
description:
Asus just put Nvidia's RTX Spark chip in a 15 cm box — and it costs $4,499.

The ASUS ProArt GR1X went on sale in the US on 18 Nov 2026: 150 × 150 × 51 mm, 1.48 kg, a 20-core CPU, a 6,144-core GPU and up to 128 GB of unified memory, with cooling rated for 140 W. The catch: no USB-A port, no headphone jack — and MSI just cut its same-chip EdgeMesa N AI+ by $300 to $4,399.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 69 — SPEC, if you run AI at your desk. Spec or wreck? Tell us below.
